description: Configuration for adding FDX Fine-Grained Consent to Keycloak authentication flow

steps.description: Add a custom authenticator execution that redirects to the consent service
instructions: 5. Select 'Script-Based Authentication' or create a custom authenticator

steps.description: Add the consent step after 'Forms' and before 'Browser - Conditional OTP'
Add consent ID to access token

notes: The consent service must be accessible from Keycloak
The consent service will handle the account selection UI
Consents are stored in Keycloak user attributes
The consent ID is added to the access token via protocol mapper
